1.why: Body text is a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height and short line lengths, but letter spacing looks near default rather than generously expanded.

2.why: All instructional copy is sentence-case, non-italic, and free of dense paragraphs; the only all-caps text sits in the testing-only Logs panel, not in the instructions.

3.why: Content is a narrow single column with large type and full-width buttons, so it reads comfortably at mobile width.

4.why: Each screen gives one or two short plain-language sentences such as 'We will send a short practice code to your account email.'

5.why: Expected inputs are illustrated by placeholders ('123456', 'ABCD-EFGH-IJKL') and by the explicit example 'The code has 6 numbers, like 123456.'

6.why: No step requires reading more than a couple of short sentences to proceed; the only longer text is the optional testing Logs panel.

7.why: 'Copy setup key' and 'Copy all codes' buttons make the long secrets copyable, and only short chunked codes ever need manual entry.

8.why: A scannable QR code is offered on the setup screen as an alternative to pasting the setup key manually.

9.why: The email and password fields are standard labeled inputs that password managers can fill, but nothing visible confirms one-time-code autofill on the code entry fields.

10.why: A 'Step X of 5' progress label and a single large blue button make the current step and primary action obvious on every screen.

11.why: Every screen presents exactly one prominent primary button, with extras like 'Hide key' and 'Send a new code' styled as quiet secondary actions.

12.why: Each transition pairs a plain heading with short next-step copy and outcomes like 'Sign-in accepted' and 'Setup complete' are stated, but most confirmations live in the testing-only Logs panel rather than on-screen messages.

13.why: 'Send a new code', 'Get a new practice code', 'Show setup key again', 'Show my codes again', 'Hide key', and the note 'Retries have no penalty' all permit penalty-free retry, reveal, and re-request.

14.why: The observed error ('We could not sign you in. Check your email and password, then try again.') states the problem and the fix in neutral, non-blaming language.

15.why: Screens state 'There is no rush' and 'no time limit for reading or retries,' and no countdown or expiry indicator appears anywhere.
